# Miscellaneous civic ledger

## Maple Clock
The Maple Clock inspection records spring tension and the walnut case finish.
The ledger gives no specification for its power source.

## Pavilions
Tern Pavilion opens at 08:40 and assigns visitors locker 12.
Wren Pavilion has a painted ceiling showing twelve swallows.

## Juniper Hall cart discussion
Minutes considered route 6 and Tuesday service for Juniper Hall's blue cart, but rejected both proposals without adopting a route or weekday.

## Solace Ferry
The Solace Ferry departs from the lower landing and has a green wheelhouse.
